recordedBy: census-v1 packet-family build worker for this family
statement: No packet was built for this family. The build stops at its first step: the official source bytes this family must be measured from are not present in this environment, so nothing downstream of them was attempted.
whatWasAsked: Bind the already-held official source, census its fields with real geometry, map every write box measured off the document, wire the product without creating authority, render fixtures, verify from the artifact bytes, and raster every page for visual review.

whyItStopped.because: The Master Library corpus is the only place the two official forms this family names exist, and it is not mounted here. It lives under private/, which is git-ignored, so the clone does not carry it and no submodule, LFS pointer, or provisioning script brings it in. MASTER_LIBRARY_SOURCE_DIR / OFFICIAL_FORMS_SOURCE_DIR are unset, and a filesystem-wide search found neither the Master Library nor the operational Nationwide Record Clearing tree.
whyItStopped.absentIsNotEmpty: This is recorded as a refusal rather than a pass for the reason scripts/rcap-official-forms/operational-corpus-precondition.mjs names: an adjudication once walked an empty file list from a missing directory and read the silence as the condition passing. A family whose bytes were never opened must not report as built.
whyItStopped.acquisitionWasNotAttempted: Correctly so. This family is SOURCE_ALREADY_HELD and commissionAcquisition is false, and this environment refuses egress to court hosts. Nothing was fetched from azcourts.gov or anywhere else. The fix is to mount the corpus that already holds these bytes, not to re-acquire them.

refusals.because: The Master Library corpus is not mounted, so no source file can be hashed and no bind is possible. An absent corpus is not an empty one: treating it as nothing-to-check would let a family whose bytes were never opened report as bound. private/ is git-ignored, so the corpus is a working input that must be mounted, not something the clone carries.

sourceBind.grantsNoAuthority: A source bind is custody of bytes and nothing else. It maps no field, proves no packet, opens no route, and requests no approval.

whatWasVerifiedWithoutTheBytes.means: source-custody-reconciliation.json and local-source-corpus-index.json name the same SHA-256 for both forms, so there is a single unambiguous digest to bind against once the bytes are mounted. This is agreement between two records. It is NOT custody, and it is NOT a verified hash.

dispositionQuestion.question: This family covers TWO dispositions -- a dismissal and a not-guilty verdict. Does the official form treat them as one selection or two?
dispositionQuestion.whyUnresolved: The brief requires this to be established FROM THE OFFICIAL FORM. The form could not be opened. Answering it from recollection of A.R.S. section 13-911, or by inferring it from the family's own name, would be exactly the kind of unmeasured claim the rest of this build forbids, and it is the claim on which the packet's legal scope turns.
dispositionQuestion.doNotCollapseUntilAnswered: If the form distinguishes the two dispositions and a single packet is shipped for both, that is the Oregon failure repeating: a route labelled for one thing delivering another. No packet was built, so nothing has been collapsed.

oregonPrecedentThatGovernsTheAnswer.whatItShows: In Oregon, ACQUITTAL and ORDINARY DISMISSAL share ONE form selection -- both are Option 2 on the same statewide OJD form, under the same subsection ORS 137.225(1)(d) -- and counsel STILL required two separate governed configurations, each with its own specification id, route key, disposition predicate, and an explicit list of what it refuses (the dismissal configuration refuses 'an acquittal, which is its own configuration').
oregonPrecedentThatGovernsTheAnswer.thereforeForArizona: Finding one checkbox on AOCCRSL1F would NOT by itself license one route for both dispositions. Oregon settled that a shared form option is compatible with distinct configurations, and that the shared base asset must be permitted expressly by counsel. Two questions must be answered, not one: what the form does, which is measurable from the bytes, and what the route identity must be, which is counsel's decision and is not made here.

revisionDiscrepancyForWhoeverBuilds.observed: The census, the custody reconciliation, the official source registry and the corpus index all name revision AOCCRSL1F-050825 / AOCCRSL2F-050825 (REV-2025-05-08). The compiled runtime profile src/lib/rcap-engine/compiled/profiles/AZ-arizona.json cites AOCCRSL1F-091424 and AOCCRSL2F-091424 throughout its agent-facing guidance.
revisionDiscrepancyForWhoeverBuilds.notActedOn: Compiled profiles are out of scope for this worker and were not modified. Flagged only, because a field map measured against 050825 and a runtime that tells participants to ask the clerk for 091424 would disagree about which document the packet is.
revisionDiscrepancyForWhoeverBuilds.forCounsel: Which revision is current at azcourts.gov is a question this environment cannot answer, having no egress to court hosts.

blanksLeftForTheParticipant: Not applicable -- no packet exists. No signature, signature date, certificate of mailing, or court-only, clerk-only, prosecutor-only or agency-only field was prefilled, because nothing was filled at all.

authorityNotCreated.why: Output legal approval is REQUESTED by a completed build, never granted by a worker. This build did not complete, so there is nothing to submit for approval and no request is made.

toUnblock: Install dependencies (node_modules is absent, so the overlay factory cannot load pdf-lib).
Mount the Master Library corpus at private/source-imports/Expungement_AI_RCAP_Master_Library_Edition_1, or point MASTER_LIBRARY_SOURCE_DIR at it.
Re-run scripts/rcap-census-v1-az-record-sealing-dismissal-not-guilty-source-bind.mjs. Exit 0 means both forms hashed to their recorded digests; exit 1 names what failed.

Only then census the fields, using the existing factory in scripts/rcap-official-forms/. The corpus index records AOCCRSL1F as an AcroForm with 71 fields across 5 pages and AOCCRSL2F as an AcroForm with 41 fields across 3 pages, so the widget census (scripts/rcap-official-forms/pdf-flattened-widgets.mjs) is the starting point and scripts/lib/pdf-stroked-boxes.mjs -- which is already CTM-aware -- confirms selection-control geometry in page coordinates.
Answer the disposition question from the measured selection controls before any packet is configured.
Take the route-identity decision to counsel, on the Oregon pattern, whatever the form turns out to do.

secondEnvironmentGap.observed: node_modules is not installed, so scripts/rcap-all50-overlay-factory-lib.mjs cannot resolve pdf-lib and no verifier that loads the overlay factory can run here (scripts/verify-all50-overlay-factory.mjs exits on ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND).
secondEnvironmentGap.preExisting: This is the state of the fresh clone and is unrelated to anything this worker wrote. No verifier was weakened, skipped or quarantined to get past it; it is reported as found.
secondEnvironmentGap.consequence: Even with the corpus mounted, a build of this family needs dependencies installed before the existing factory can census fields or render fixtures.
